banner: Demo mode: sign-in is disabled. Your checkups are saved only in this browser.

home.intro: Take a photo of a leaf from your crop. We'll tell you what disease it has, how serious it is, what medicine to use, and how much crop you could lose if you wait.
home.exampleAdvice: You could lose 30% of your crop if not treated. Use Propiconazole spray within 5–7 days.
home.step1Desc: Click a clear picture of one leaf in daylight.
home.step2Desc: We check the leaf and tell you the disease.
home.step3Desc: See what to spray and how much crop is at risk.

predict.title: Analyze a leaf
predict.waking: Waking up the model… the first check after a quiet spell can take up to 30 seconds.

upload.browse: drag & drop, or click to browse

history.title: Field log
history.emptyHint: Check a leaf to start your record

result.notReviewed: This Hindi advice has not yet been checked by an agriculture expert. Keep chemical names and doses exactly as written, and confirm with your local agriculture officer.
result.yieldLoss: Estimated loss of {{pct}}% if left untreated.
result.leanings: What the model leaned towards (not a diagnosis)

rejected.title: Photo not clear enough
rejected.message: We could not read this photo well enough to check the leaf. Please take it again.

notLeaf.title: No leaf found
notLeaf.message: This photo does not seem to show a plant leaf. Please photograph the leaf you want checked.

uncertain.title: We're not sure about this one
uncertain.message: This photo doesn't look like the {{crop}} leaves our model has learned from, so we won't guess a disease. Please retake it, or ask a local agriculture officer.

tips.too_small: Use the full camera resolution and move a little closer.
tips.blurry: Hold the phone steady and tap the leaf on screen to focus before taking the photo.
tips.too_dark: Take the photo in daylight, not at night or in deep shade.
tips.too_bright: Avoid harsh direct sun or flash glare. Shade the leaf with your body.
tips.no_leaf: Fill most of the frame with one leaf, about 20–30 cm from the camera.
tips.unreadable_image: The file could not be opened. Try a JPG or PNG photo.
tips.unfamiliar_image: Check that the right crop is selected, then photograph a single leaf of that crop.
tips.low_confidence: Check that the right crop is selected, then photograph a single leaf of that crop.

generalTips.oneLeaf: One leaf, filling most of the frame

feedback.question: Was this correct?
feedback.thanksCorrection: Thank you. Your correction will be checked by an expert.
feedback.saveFailed: Could not save your answer. Please try again.
feedback.listFailed: Could not load the list. Please try again.

location.title: Add your location? (optional)
location.why: It helps show where diseases are spreading, so nearby farmers and officers can act early. Your exact location is never shown to anyone: the public map only shows areas of about 5 km² where at least 3 different people reported.
location.on: Location: shared (only an approximate area is ever public)

map.title: Where diseases are being reported
map.intro: Each hexagon is an area of about 5 km². It appears only when at least 3 different people reported a disease there, so no single farm can be identified.
map.empty: No area has enough reports for this filter yet.
map.failed: Could not load the map. Please try again.
map.demo: DEMO DATA: made-up points for a local demo, not real reports.

privacy.title: Your data
privacy.stored: For each checkup: the leaf photo (made smaller, with hidden camera data such as GPS removed), the diagnosis and advice, the heatmap, your answer to "Was this correct?", and a random ID for this browser. Your location only if you chose to share it.
privacy.public: Nothing that identifies you. The public map only shows how many disease reports came from an area of about 5 km², and only when at least 3 different browsers reported there. Your exact location, photos and checkups are never shown to anyone else.
privacy.location: Taken only after you agree: from your phone's location or, if that isn't available, from the location saved in the photo. You can stop sharing any time with "Change" on the Diagnose page.
privacy.delete: This removes every checkup made in this browser, with its photos, from our servers. It cannot be undone. Do it before clearing your browser data: after that we can no longer tell which checkups were yours.
privacy.failed: Could not delete your data. Please try again.

field.why: Uses free Sentinel-2 satellite images of your field from the last 4 months.
field.loading: Checking satellite images… this can take up to 30 seconds.
field.failed: Satellite data is unavailable right now. Please try again shortly.
field.title: Field from space

flag.below_once: Below neighbouring fields on {{date}}. Wait for the next clear image to confirm.
flag.no_neighbours: Not enough clear farmland nearby to compare with.
flag.no_clear: No clear satellite view in the last 4 months (clouds).

field.stale: No clear image since {{date}} (clouds), so this may be out of date.
field.chartLabel: Greenness of your field and of nearby fields over time
field.redsiNote: Experimental research index for wheat yellow rust: lower means more stress. Not a diagnosis.
field.explain: The satellite shows whether the field is under stress, not which disease. The leaf photo tells which disease.
field.meta: {{clear}} of {{total}} satellite images were clear; last clear image: {{date}}.
field.circle: Field = a 30 m circle around your location (field boundaries not available).
